items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Matter of fact, I played with Boynel with learning a lot of these, uh, riffs and everything... at that particular job at the doghouse... Boynel Santiago was playing, uh, piano.

ctx.x: That's right. Mr. and Mrs. Martinez used to own a doghouse. Big fat woman, great big woman. And the man was a little bit of skinny man like that, man. Boy, that was a combination. And both of them used to get drunk. Boy, I didn't raise them saying anything. They raised more than the customers raised. Well, in that band, in that band, uh, I was playing trumpet. My brother-in-law, Eddie Johnson, was playing saxophone. My brother-in-law, Boynel Santiago. Did y'all know about Boynel? Oh, yeah. We know about him.
Lester told us a little bit about him. Lester, that's right.
